title: JayMan146's Bonus Enchants
description: Adds a max health enchantment and attack speed enchantment.
body:
Adds two enchantments:
* Constitution, which gives you two extra hearts per level, up to level three.
* Slashing, which increases attack speed by 0.25 per level, up to level three.

Watch [this video](https://youtu.be/xHCFfZ0b_SY) to learn about it, though it is a little outdated.

Please credit me if you use this datapack in any sort of public or profitable manner.
